purpose: Prospective full-grid check of the already registered 4 mm rung: all four coaxial B3 controls, 201 frequencies from 500 to 2500 Hz, unchanged F13-SCIENCE-VALUES-01 bands and independent N20/N40 mode matching. The old 8 mm finding remains. This is public DEVELOPMENT engineering evidence, not full-family acceptance or qualification.

recommended.basis: Local 4 mm small-coaxial 21-point diagnostic: 112359 nodes, 341.47 CPU-s solve, 620.4 MiB peak, 16.26 CPU-s per frequency. Full 201-point and other geometry costs are extrapolated. Two jobs bound the worker's existing 16 GiB per-case limits within 64 GiB including the independent mode-matching worker. Live offers and full-deadline reservations are checked by the operator; the phase remains capped at USD25.

steps.name: harness-numpy
argv: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends python3-numpy python3-scipy > {work}/apt.log 2>&1 && dpkg-query -W python3-numpy python3-scipy > {out}/harness-packages.txt

steps.name: f13-coaxial-4mm-dense
steps.judges: All four controls must have exactly 201 FEM and N20/N40 reference frequencies. Existing B3: resolved pointwise 0.5 dB, notch floor 1e-3 W, p10/mean 0.25 dB, extrema 10 Hz, mode matching N20/N40 0.05 dB; any observer finding fails. Missing coverage stays NOT_RUN. Exit nonzero unless this bounded four-control check passes; other family checks remain separate.
